summary: Use workload errors and hardware telemetry together to distinguish application faults, resource exhaustion and device health incidents.
outcomes: Interpret error and telemetry evidence without assigning every failure to hardware.
Construct a reproducible health incident report with an escalation path.
sequence: Compare a bad pointer, out-of-memory event and device fault.
Correlate application timestamps with error and health records.
Explain ECC reporting, Xid classes and diagnostic limits.
Run only appropriate supported diagnostics on disposable or permitted resources.
Decide retry, drain or escalation from evidence.

visual.question: Which observations distinguish software failure from a device-health problem?
visual.interaction: Reveal logs and telemetry in order and revise the diagnosis.

practice.task: Diagnose three synthetic incidents and write evidence-based runbooks.
practice.success: Runbook separates observation, hypothesis, diagnostic action and recovery; no invented guarantee of fault detection.
